Maple Ridge Community Clinic
Office Visit - Follow-up
Patient: Farid Zielinski | DOB: 05/24/1994 | MRN: SYN-6953259
Date of service: 05/21/2025 | Dr. Kaveh Bellamy, MD

History of present illness:
30-year-old man seen for follow-up of low back pain. Low back pain radiating to the left leg for 14 weeks.

Treatment to date:
Completed 7 weeks of physical therapy and daily naproxen without adequate relief.

History:
Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hypertension.
Medications: metformin 500 mg twice daily; lisinopril 10 mg daily.

Review of systems:
Red flag screen negative: denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer.

Physical exam:
Back: tenderness over the lower lumbar paraspinal muscles; straight-leg raise positive on the left at 45 degrees.
Neuro: strength 4/5 in left ankle dorsiflexion and great toe extension, reflexes 2+ and symmetric, decreased light touch over the dorsum of the left foot.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: left L5 lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to evaluate for disc herniation; home exercise program; follow up after imaging.
